scope: Deterministic stub evaluation of bounded experience reuse only. No model call, network access, paid execution or wall-clock measurement: this contract can reject a broken reuse rule but cannot show that any model gets better. A real learning-on/off comparison still requires the M1 approved window.

design.learningOff: No experience is consulted; the stub has no lesson text and answers 'unknown' for every case (hits are 0 by construction).
design.learningOn: selectExperience(limit=6, maxBytes=600) over the frozen stub library; the stub follows the selected lesson text only.
design.comparison: Paired per-case hit delta (learningOn hits - learningOff hits) over the identical frozen case set.
design.measurement: A case is a hit only when its expected lesson is selected, that lesson contains the case expectToken, and every selected lesson clears held-out separation for the case.
design.misleadingControl: One misleading lesson is selected for the control cue but cannot satisfy the control expectToken. It must be rejected or neutral, contribute no gain, and never be counted as a gain.
design.determinism: The same contract bytes and the same library produce a byte-identical receipt (no clock, path or ordering input).

misleading.verdictRule: rejected when selected and the lesson lacks the control expectToken; neutral only when not selected; accepted is always a failure and a missing control measurement is never neutral

stoppingRule: One frozen run over the frozen case set; no retries, no re-runs that drop a failing case and no post-hoc threshold edits. A failing threshold is final for this contract. Changing any case, threshold, exclusion, library entry or the misleading rule requires a new contract file whose contractSha256 differs, committed before the next run. A missing or non-finite measurement is an exclusion, never a pass.
